title: Two outcomes for the same toy unit
hook: Two stated cases: explore the contrast between two modeled potential outcomes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the contrast between two modeled potential outcomes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Effect, regardless of the stated inputs.
